newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade at $68, slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade at $68, slow - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area on Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry.

Sales reported on 6,100 slaughter steers and 600 heifers; 85,000 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 8 loads or 300 head CME cattle delivered to area packing plants, 13,800 head formulated and 300 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 68.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 68.00.
Wk to date - 85,000 Week Ago - 95,000 Year Ago - 59,800
